import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))

# Create a 2x2 grid of scatter plots showing relationships between features
features = ['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']
species = df['species'].unique()
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Plot 1: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax1.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 2: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax2.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 3: Sepal Length vs Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
for sp in species:
    subset = df[df['species'] == sp]
    ax3.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['petal_length'], 
                alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sp, color=colors[sp])
ax3.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_title('Sepal Length vs Petal Length', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Species')

# Plot 4: Box plot of all features
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
box_data = []
labels = []
for feature in features:
    for sp in species:
        box_data.append(df[df['species'] == sp][feature].values)
        labels.append(f'{feature}\n({sp})')

positions = np.arange(len(box_data))
box = ax4.boxplot(box_data, positions=positions, widths=0.6, patch_artist=True)

# Color the boxes by species
colors_list = []
for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    for sp, color in colors.items():
        if sp in label:
            colors_list.append(color)
            break

for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors_list):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax4.set_xticks(positions)
ax4.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Features by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Add overall title
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Visualization: Feature Relationships and Distributions', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
